caption: The drawing depicts a doll-like figure in a full-length outfit. The figure has a round head with a pale face, dark eyes, and a closed mouth, framed by a tan-colored cloth headscarf tied in a large bow under the chin. The upper body is clothed in a light pink long-sleeved top with subtle vertical stripes and a textured pattern on the sleeves, while the hands are dark brown or black, possibly gloved. The figure wears a pale green apron that drapes over the front of the skirt and is tied at the waist, and the long skirt below is light pink with soft darker pink strokes giving a sense of folds and movement. The background is plain and off-white, and the composition centers the figure on the page with ample empty space around it. The artist’s signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Doll
